title: Ruoholahti → Länsiväylä → Lauttasaari → Koivusaari
description: Drivable corridor west from Ruoholahti along Porkkalankatu and Länsiväylä over Lauttasaari and Koivusaari to the Espoo border, with Lauttasaarentie into Lauttasaari centre.

legs.label: Porkkalankatu → Lauttasaari bridge → Länsiväylä → Koivusaari → Espoo border
Länsiväylä from Ruoholahti past Salmisaari to the Lauttasaari bridge

limitations: Terrain is flat, as in the rest of Helsinki; Länsiväylä's bridges and ramps are drawn at street level.
Länsiväylä's grade-separated interchanges are flattened, so ramps and the motorway meet where in reality one passes over the other.
Helsinki's textured 3D model ends at the Espoo border; the corridor continues on Espoo's own city model (extension espoo).
